comment: I'm sorry but I genuinely had to fight sleep every class. His slides were very confusing and if you ever miss class it feels like you miss 4 units since he moves very fast. I know this class is supposed to be hard but the fact that the only grades we have in the class are from the exams make it even worse.
Cool professor. No drama. Very accommodating.

Everything was extremely straightforward. He gave us what we needed and let us do the lab. He was very loosey goosey with what we could do in lab and still get results (this is a good thing) and he explained concepts well. He did not hold us over time, but labs often took the full class period.

Dr. O'Neal was a wonderful lab professor! He was always willing to answer questions and had materials well organized on his website. He was understanding when mistakes were made during lab work and worked with students to find a reasonable way to continue and prevent similar mistakes in the future.

Dr. O'Neal is an amazing professor! Very helpful during lab if you have questions about anything. Very clear on his grading and gives great feedback on the lab notebooks. All the assignments made sense and nothing felt like busy work. He was always available outside of class and I would definitely recommend going to office hours if you need help.

The best organic chemistry lab professor! He gives great feedback for lab notebooks and answers questions during lab if you're lost. I would recommend going to office hours because he is very helpful with analyzing data (and he's hilarious).

He's great. Can wander off sometimes when you need help (bc managing a lot of students), but explains things very well when you flag him down. Gives very specific feedback on where you lost points in lab reports which is helpful. If you need help try to contact him as early as possible bc he's not a big fan of emails the day/night before.

I had Dr. O'Neal for the lab portion of both CHEM 205 and CHEM 206, and he was fantastic! He gave excellent feedback on project reports and was consistently available for office hours. It is evident he cares about his students and he was always clear with his expectations. I would highly recommend taking 205/206 lab with him!
